Rotate PDF

Turn pages the right way up — permanently.

Rotate every page or only the ones that are sideways. The change is written into the PDF, so it looks right everywhere.

Processed entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded, stored or retained by Paperly.

How Rotate PDF works

  1. Add your PDF and preview the first pages.
  2. Rotate all pages or enter a specific page range and angle.
  3. Download the corrected file.

Limitations

Results depend on the input document. Always keep the original file until you have verified the output.

Related tools

  • Organize PDF — Reorder, rotate and remove pages visually.
  • Crop PDF — Trim margins and give every page a clean edge.
